1. `src/sqllens/server.py` lines 334-347: nothing but a code comment requires tools and resources to be registered through the `_tool` / `_resource` helpers. `build_server` still has the raw `mcp` object in scope, so a later `@mcp.tool` would register without the `_tool_errors` wrapper. (raised by 1/6 agents)
2. `src/sqllens/server.py`: no test checks that every registered tool and resource is wrapped by `_tool` / `_resource`. The error-text tests cover only `query_database`, `import_memory`, `export_memories` and one widget resource, so a bypass on another tool would fail no test. This is the same root cause as item 1, filed under a different kind, so it does not corroborate item 1 by signature. (raised by 1/6 agents)

An operator cannot tell an SDK type change apart from an oversized caller payload. The function still fails secure to `{}`. (raised by 1/6 agents)

The same section says an `MCPError` becomes a JSON-RPC error, and errors raised outside the tool's function keep the SDK's own text.
